simple.meaning: יַלְדָּה (yaldâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a lass.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יַלְדָּה (H3207) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 34:4, with occurrences in Genesis, Joel, Zechariah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יַלְדָּה (H3207) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יַלְדָּה (H3207) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יַלְדָּה (yaldâh) / H3207 is traced through Genesis 34:4, Joel 4:3, Zechariah 8:5 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3207. yaldah יַלְדָּה noun feminine girl, damsel ; — absolute יִלְדָּה Gen 34:4 ; Joel 4:3; וִילָדוֺת Zech 8:5 ; — marriageable girl: of Dinah, daughter of Jacob Gen 34:4 ; opposed to יֶלֶד Zech 8:5 ; Joel 4:3.

occurrences.englishText: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”
The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”
